# Agent review instructions

> Apply the repository contract when writing or reviewing changes.

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
Cite stable rule IDs in review findings and prioritize provider correctness,
financial precision, credential handling, trading ambiguity, and session recovery.
The crate is a documentation-only WIP scaffold; do not infer API coverage from CI.
State the actual authoring model in every agent-authored GitHub publication.
